methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 high-search hair dryer models spanning 2016-2025, re-verified against manufacturer product pages (dyson.com, t3micro.com, sharkninja.com, laifentech.com, ghdhair.com, babylisspro.com) and major retailers (Ulta, Target, NT Electronics, Amazon) plus reviews (TechAdvisor, TechRadar). Wattage and heat/speed settings taken from official spec tables; weight reported in grams (1 lb = 453.6 g, 1 oz = 28.35 g). Where a manufacturer states a single rounded weight (e.g. Dyson '1.8 lb') that figure is used over third-party measured values for consistency. Boolean specs true when named in official copy, false when absent everywhere, null when not determinable. Prices are published US MSRP / current list price on manufacturer or major-retailer pages as of accessedAt 2026-06-15; sale prices noted separately. Adversarial pass corrected the Dyson Supersonic Origin attachment list and weight; all other products verified accurate.
